name: paired-t-test-calculator
description: A responsive browser-based paired samples t test calculator with p-values, confidence intervals, effect size, paired visualization, and APA-style results.

paragraphs: Paired T-Test Calculator is a lightweight, browser-based statistics tool for comparing two related sets of measurements. It is designed for students, researchers, analysts, educators, and anyone who needs to run a paired-samples t test without installing statistical software or sending data to a remote calculation service. A typical use case is a before-and-after study in which the same participants are measured twice, but the same workflow also applies to matched pairs and repeated measurements under two related conditions.

The project focuses on completing the practical task around the statistical test, not merely producing a p-value. Users can see the exact row-by-row pairing, review the calculated differences, obtain descriptive and inferential statistics, visualize paired changes, copy an APA-style result, and download the calculated values as CSV. The interface is responsive and works on desktop and mobile screens. It is implemented entirely with static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript so it can be hosted directly with GitHub Pages.
